dataset: NASA LRO LOLA South Pole DEM (LDEM_80S_20M / 5M)

sites.name: Shackleton Crater Rim
sites.notes: Narrow elevated crater rim adjacent to Shackleton PSR; moderate local slopes with steep interior walls nearby.

sites.name: Connecting Ridge
sites.notes: High-elevation ridge linking Shackleton and de Gerlache craters; relatively smooth local landing patches.

sites.name: Malapert Massif
sites.notes: Prominent massif ~120 km from the South Pole; high elevation and strong Earth line-of-sight with steeper flank gradients.
